records.title: Senior Manager, Asia Manufacturing Strategy & Operations
records.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Global Innovation, oversees performance management, operational excellence, and strategic execution for manufacturing entities across Asia, including Vietnam, China, and South Korea. Serves as a key liaison between headquarters and regional production sites, driving data‑driven decision‑making, productivity improvements, and process standardization.
 
 
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Management & Financial Oversight
* Monitor and evaluate the operational and financial performance of manufacturing subsidiaries in Asia
* Develop and manage KPIs
* Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with regional leadership
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans
* Strategic Planning & Execution
* Formulate mid- to long-term manufacturing and supply chain strategies aligned with global business objectives
* Support capacity planning, cost optimization, and footprint strategy (e.g., China+1, nearshoring)
* Conduct market and operational feasibility analysis for new investments or expansions
* Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across production sites (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen)
* Standardize processes and implement best practices across regions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Procurement, Logistics, Quality, R&D) to improve end-to-end efficiency
* HQ–Regional Coordination
* Act as the primary liaison between HQ and Asia manufacturing teams
* Ensure alignment on corporate policies, reporting standards, and operational priorities
* Facilitate communication, issue resolution, and project execution across time zones

records.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.
 
 
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager of MFG Engineering Programs in our New Product Introduction group, you will be responsible and accountable to lead and deliver global nuclear fuel manufacturing project execution across Westinghouse Electric Corporation (WEC) fuel manufacturing facilities in the US, UK & Sweden operations. You will be deployed to guide progress and execution of multiple projects within our organization, based on the program needs. The Sr Manager owns the global manufacturing scope of new product introduction and is accountable to lead project execution to delivery in-full, without complaint products to our customers while meeting safety and financial goals. This position will guide interaction between Fuel Engineering, Nuclear Fuel Project Managers, Product Delivery & Commercial Managers, Product Management, Supply Chain, SIOP, Plant Manufacturing Managers, Global Quality, and Supplier or customer teams. It will also coordinate on project deliverables, issues, and resolution. Program budget accountability ranges from $1M - $20M.
 
 
You will report to the Director of New Product Introduction and support the role remotely with 25 - 35% travel between global manufacturing facilities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehend entire program scope, such as commercial, licensing, regulatory and initiate appropriate scope within the manufacturing program scope.
* Support project task-based schedules and track/report milestone progress against the program management plan.
* Deploy strategies for optimizing and streamlining legacy fuel manufacturing operations in partnership with manufacturing sites and functional leads.
* Analyze existing processes and identify value-added and non-value-added activities to solve design challenges.
* Manage project risks and opportunities to closure in partnership with functional leads and Program Managers. Identify issues, propose solutions and lead recovery plans to closure.
* Implement within project schedule and budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-savings opportunities. Communicate with partners, providing updates on project milestones, risks, critical escalations and issues.
* Present strategic project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior leadership and important partners.
* Identify areas of improvement or gaps in current processes and develop strategies to promote efficiency and productivity in new product and process introduction.
* Perform as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support project teams in new product and process development such as APQP and PPAP industry standards.
* Compare actual performance against planned performance to identify variances and help manage tasks on project planning.
* Collaborate with program team members and departments to establish plans and schedules that allocate resources to best achieve program requirements and service internal and external client or customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering.
* 10 -15 years related experience in Nuclear/ Automotive/ Heavy Engineering/ Metals Industry / Manufacturing / Assembly.
* Experience with project management and new product introduction into manufacturing.
* Analytical capabilities to identify critical schedule paths and improve engineering / supply chain timelines.
* Demonstrated skills in internal operational partner relationship management.
* Advance level PMI certification in Project Management.
* Experience of Engineering Component Manufacturing systems.
* Experience with engineering product development including design phases, manufacturing processes and global supply chain management.
* Familiarization with Kaizen, Lean Operations, FMEA's, DMAIC, DFMAs, POCA cycles.
* Familiarization with Microsoft Project, P6 or other scheduling software.

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $144,000 to $180,000 per year.
 
 
**Why Westinghouse?**
**Benefits**
**Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:**

* Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options
* Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members
* 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement
* Paid Vacations and Company Holidays
* Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work-life balance
* Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers
* Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service
* Employee Referral Program

Westinghouse Electric Company Is The Global Nuclear Energy Industry's First Choice For Safe, Clean, And Efficient Energy Solutions. We Enable Our Delivery Of This Vision By Living Our Value System
 
 

* Safety and Quality
* Integrity and Trust
* Customer Focus and Innovation
* Speed and Passion to Win
* Teamwork and Accountability

**While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting**
http://www.westinghousenuclear.com .
 
 
Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities

**Twitter**

**LinkedIn |**
**YouTube**

records.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
records.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

records.title: Senior Manager, Operations Program Manager
records.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.
 
 
Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.
 
 
As a Senior Manager, Operations Program Manager, you will lead a team responsible for driving hardware programs across the full product lifecycle — from New Product Introduction (NPI) through sustaining and high-volume mass production. This pivotal leadership role demands a seasoned expert capable of mentoring a high-performing team of Operations Program Managers, architecting capacity and ramp plans, and managing executive-level relationships with global Contract Manufacturers to optimize yield, quality, throughput, and cost. With over a decade of experience in hardware operations and a deep mastery of the full product lifecycle, you will drive cross-functional alignment from early development through mass production, oversee multi-million dollar capital expenditures, and navigate complex supply chain risks. We are looking for a financially-savvy leader with exceptional executive presence who is ready to optimize global operations and shape the future of our manufacturing footprint.
 
 
This is a US Hybrid role (3 days per week) based in our San Francisco, California office.
 
 
**What You Will Do**

* Strategic Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of Operations Program Managers spanning NPI and Sustaining programs, bridging product innovation and global manufacturing excellence across the full lifecycle.
* Program Delivery: Drive supply chain readiness for new product launches and sustaining programs, ensuring delivery on schedule, scale, cost, and quality from EVT through high-volume mass production. Owning programs end to end.
* Global Factory Operations: Oversee on-the-ground factory operations and own executive-level relationships with Contract Manufacturers (CMs), ensuring KPIs for yield, quality, and throughput are consistently met or exceeded across all programs.
* NPI Execution: Lead NPI program execution from concept through PRQ, partnering with Engineering and Product Management on supplier down-selections, launch strategy, and ramp planning.
* Sustaining & Lifecycle Strategy: Lead the Post Ramp Qualification (PRQ) framework, making high-stakes decisions on product changes necessitated by material shortages, quality improvements, or cost-reduction initiatives.
* Business Planning & Demand: Partner with Executive Leadership (Planning, Sourcing, Retail, Product, and Finance) to ensure global supply matches demand, owning the mitigation strategy for any supply chain disruptions.
* Infrastructure & Capacity: Architect the long-term capacity plan, including the strategic deployment of multi-million dollar capital expenditures for equipment, fixtures, and factory expansion across NPI and mass production.
* Risk & Material Management: Partner with MPMs on Materials Management strategy, proactively identifying systemic supply chain risks and implementing hedging or dual-sourcing strategies.
* Budgetary Oversight: Own the operational budget for NPI and Sustaining programs, including accountability for Opex, Capex, and variance reporting.

**We would love to have you on our team if you have:**

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in Hardware Operations, Technical Program Management, or Engineering Leadership across both NPI and sustaining/mass production phases, with at least 3 years in a formal people management role.
* Proven Leadership: A track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing teams in complex, fast-paced hardware environments, leading teams for 3+ years.
* Full Lifecycle Mastery: Deep expertise leading programs across all stages of the product lifecycle — from EVT and DVT through PVT, MP ramp, and sustaining — and across all Hardware disciplines (EE, ME, ID) and Supply Chain functions (Sourcing, Quality, Logistics, and Global Planning).
* Factory-Floor Expertise: Significant experience working directly on-site at international manufacturing facilities (JDM/ODM models), with a deep understanding of assembly lines, test stations, and factory floor dynamics.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex operational challenges into clear, actionable insights for C-suite executives.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing large-scale budgets and a sophisticated understanding of the financial drivers behind manufacturing and supply chain operations.
* Self-Driven Excellence: A relentless drive to optimize processes and a passion for mentoring the next generation of hardware leaders.
* Global Mobility: Ability to travel internationally and domestically (up to 30%) to interface with partners and oversee factory builds.

**Benefits**
At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own, and we are continually looking to improve employee health.
 
 
**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
* 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
* Paid sick leave and parental leave

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.
 
 
**San Francisco Salary Range: $172,550-$203,000**
ŌURA is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at ŌURA are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.
 
 
We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
 
 
Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
 
 
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:
 
 

* Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.
* We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.
* Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.
 
 
To all recruitment agencies: ŌURA does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ŌURA employees, or any other organization's location. ŌURA is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

records.title: Senior Manager, Product Development & Production
records.description:
Studs is a category-defining ear piercing and earring brand named one of "the 10 most innovative companies in retail for 2023" by Fast Company. Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.
 
 
The Senior Manager of Product Development & Production is responsible for execution of proposed product and design. They will take the product from the proposed design state to commercialization including physical product development and final production. They will also be responsible for building out a team org structure and training new team members
 
 
**Salary Range:**
$130,000
 
 
**Key Responsibilities:**
Product Development
 
 

* Establish strategic partnerships with suppliers, manufacturers, and other vendors in order to develop new products or improve existing products
* Oversee the product life cycle of new products from concept to commercialization
* Develop and manage the development calendar with milestones that aligns with the organization's strategic objective
* Manage all vendor WIPs, sample requests and inbound samples
* Price negotiation to achieve margin goals
* Work with external partners on brand collaboration products and key initiatives

Production
 
 

* Oversee production process from PO placement through ex-factory including vendor payment and credits
* Ensure bulk goods produced conform with approved designs and standards
* Set factory allocation to ensure they align with factories' capacity supporting the businesses growth and key initiatives
* Negotiate bulk inventory costs, lead times and deliveries
* Manage and resolve any manufacturing issues including delivery delays with factories
* Communicate delivery timelines and collaborate with cross functional partners on product launches

Testing & Relations
 
 

* Foster and maintain vendor relationships
* Lead on boarding process ensuring factory and vendor adherence to Stud's processes and standards, and that clear understanding of processes and nuances between vendors is maintained
* Develop and monitor, and continually improve quality assurance procedures and processes with external testing vendors
* Ensure all products manufactured that will be commercially sold are tested to STUDS standards prior to shipment
* Evaluate, improve, and define processes and policies, process implementation, and identify errors and areas of improvement
* Address the root causes of quality issues, create corrective action plans and implement long term solutions in partnership with external vendors

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience in product development and/or production, with hands-on ownership of products from concept through bulk delivery.
* Jewelry experience strongly preferred, but not required. Experience in accessories or another consumer product category is a plus.
* Retail or DTC brand experience a plus, especially in a multi-channel business (physical retail and ecommerce).
* 2+ years of people management experience, or a demonstrated record of training and developing team members. Interest in building a team structure from the ground up.
* Proven track record managing overseas and domestic factory partners, including vendor onboarding, factory allocation, and capacity planning.
* Highly organized, with the ability to run a development calendar across many SKUs, vendors, and launches at once in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Clear, direct communicator who works well across functions, including Merchandising, Finance, Retail, and Marketing.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills. AI fluency preferred: comfortable using AI tools in daily work to move faster.
* Based in New York, NY and able to work from the HQ office on a hybrid schedule.
* Driven, creative problem solver that consistently acts with integrity and speaks up
* Owner's mindset, with the ability to approach feedback and problems with a positive attitude.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Flexible Work Environment (3 days in office, 2 days work from home)
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (including a plan option with $0 in-network mental health visits)
* Access to Mental Health and Work/Life Resources including Online Therapy, Gender Affirmation Support Services, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Health and Commuter Tax-Advantaged Accounts
* Stock Options in connection with the Company's Equity Incentive Plan
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
* Paid Time Off, Paid Safe & Sick Leave, and Paid Parental Leave
* Paid Sabbatical After 4 Years of Service
* Exclusive Employee Discounts on Piercings and Jewelry (we've got your friends and family covered too!)
* Access to PerkSpot and additional benefits such as pet insurance, discounted tickets, personal finance coaching, healthy rewards, and more!

*Studs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a work environment that fosters diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity without regard to race, color, gender, age, creed, sex, religion, national origin, disability (physical or mental), marital status, citizenship, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, or any other legally protected status. Studs considers qualified applicants with criminal histories. We comply with applicable state and local laws prohibiting discrimination in employment in every jurisdiction in which we operate. If you require an accommodation for the application process, please email HRBP@studs.com.*
*Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*
*Click here for the Studs Privacy Notice for California Applicants.*

records.title: Director, Quality Operations
records.description:
**Revvity**

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity.

Our team is seeking a Director, Quality Operations to lead site quality for the Hopkinton-based operation. This role succeeds the current site quality leadership position and is intentionally scoped at the Director level because it combines broad operational accountability, organizational build-out, and a significant quality-system integration mandate. The Director will lead a blended Quality Operations organization spanning product quality, quality systems, supplier and incoming quality, inspection, and production support. The successful leader must protect ongoing product quality and compliance while progressively simplifying, integrating, and modernizing the operating model.

 
 

**Routine Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

**Site Quality Leadership and Governance**
------------------------------------------

* Quality Operations leader for Hopkinton, with accountability for product quality, manufacturing quality, inspection, release, and site QMS execution.

* Provide visible, hands-on leadership in production and laboratory environments, enabling rapid risk-based decisions and timely escalation of material, process, product, and compliance issues.

* Own the site quality operating rhythm, including management review, quality metrics, risk review, resource prioritization, and cross-functional governance with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, R&D, Regulatory, Service, and Commercial teams.

* Serve as the principal site Quality representative for FDA, ISO, notified-body, customer, and internal audits, and ensure sustained inspection readiness across the blended operation.

* Balance product continuity, customer commitments, compliance, and transformation priorities using documented risk-based decisions.

 
 

**QMS, SOP, and Digital-System Integration**
--------------------------------------------

* Create and execute a phased roadmap improve and sustain SOPs and QMS structures supporting the site, with clear process ownership, sequencing, change controls, validation needs, and business-continuity safeguards.

* Optimize operating model for document control, production records, training, calibration, internal audits, supplier management, incoming inspection, final acceptance, complaints, and customer field interfaces.

* Lead the integration and modernization of quality tools and records currently distributed across systems and methods.

* Partner with enterprise Quality, Regulatory, IT/Digital, and business process owners to deploy scalable solutions and eliminate duplicate or conflicting workflows, records, and controls.

* Ensure data integrity, validated-state control, traceability, retention, access, and training are maintained throughout system and process transitions.

 
 

**Product and Manufacturing Quality**
-------------------------------------

* Lead quality support for a diverse portfolio that includes instruments, consumables and reagents platforms.

* Oversee incoming inspection, in-process controls, final product acceptance and release, nonconformance and material-review processes, manufacturing investigations, and CAPA effectiveness.

* Ensure appropriate validation and verification of manufacturing processes, equipment, software-enabled tools, inspection methods, and test methods.

* Drive preventive product-quality improvements using defect, yield, scrap, complaint, service, supplier, and Cost of Poor Quality trends.

* Represent Quality in design transfer, manufacturing transfer, new-product introduction, supplier changes, capacity expansion, and sustaining-engineering decisions.

 
 

**Organization Build and People Leadership**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team of Quality Systems, Product Quality, Supplier/Incoming Quality, Quality Control, inspection, technician, and specialist roles.

* Implement planned organization expansion, including Quality Systems leadership, compliance coordination, QC supervision, and temporary integration support, while clarifying accountability across product and system responsibilities.

* Build succession depth and technical capability through coaching, performance management, role clarity, development plans, and targeted cross-training across legacy product and QMS environments.

* Set clear performance expectations and foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, timely decision-making, and practical continuous improvement.

* Plan resource needs and manage the site Quality Operations budget, contractor usage, and external support in line with the operating plan.

 
 

**Customer, Supplier, and Compliance Interface**
------------------------------------------------

* Own the Quality Operations response to significant customer issues, quality agreements, customer audits, field escalations, and product-quality communications in partnership with Commercial Quality and Regulatory.

* Provide governance for supplier quality and incoming-quality activities, including risk-based controls, supplier corrective action, change assessment, and escalation of supply continuity risks.

* Ensure complaints, quality events, CAPAs, deviations, nonconformances, and risk-management activities are documented, investigated, assessed, and closed with appropriate rigor and timeliness.

* Responsible for customer complaint handling and investigations in collaboration with cross functional teams driving problem solving and resolution plans.

Maintain effective QMS training, document control, internal audit, calibration, and records-management programs across the site scope.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* bachelors degree
* 15+ years of quality experience with 7+ years management experience
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting instruments, reagents and consumable product lines and systems.
* Experience deploying or consolidating eQMS, ERP, PLM, inspection, training, document-control, or calibration systems.
* Lean, Six Sigma, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, or comparable credentials.
* Experience hosting regulatory and customer audits and managing complex customer-quality interfaces.
* Experience with data analysis, analytics, and management reporting schemes.
 

 

**Physical Requirements & Expectations:**

* The primary working condition associated with this position is working independently in the office environment.
* It is frequently required to work cross-functionally. Travel may be required up to 10%.
* Requires the ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds, sit and/or stand for prolonged periods of time and effectively manage conflict and emotional or stressful situations.
* Potential hazards associated with blood products.

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

 
 

**Compensation Range:**

The annual base salary range for this full-time position is $159,000 - $185,000. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for a new hire in this position. The base pay actually offered to the successful candidate will take into account internal equity, work location, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that base pay is only one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This range allows for the successful candidate to have an opportunity to progress within the position and develop at our company. This base pay range does not take into account bonuses, equity, or other benefits which may be applicable and are dependent on the level and position offered.

#LI-CH1

 
 
 

**What do we offer?**

We provide competitive and comprehensive benefits to our employees. Below are some highlights of our benefits:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Options
* Life and Disability Insurance
* Paid Time-Off
* Parental Benefits
* Compassionate Care Leave
* 401k with Company Match
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Learn more about Revvity’s benefits by visiting our Bswift (opens in new window) page. Log-In instructions are provided towards the bottom of the Bswift page.

*For benefit-eligible roles only. Part-time and temporary roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed. Please reach out to your recruiter for more information.*

**Recruitment Scam Alert**

We've become aware that scammers are impersonating members of our recruitment team by using fake email addresses and fraudulent job opportunities.

Please remember:

We will never ask you to pay for an interview, job offer, equipment, training, or any part of our recruitment process. Always verify that recruitment emails come from our official company email domain (revvity.com). Revvity will never conduct interviews via text message, messaging apps, or social media direct messages. If you're ever unsure whether a recruitment message is genuine, please contact us through our official careers website before responding.
 
 
Your safety is important to us.
 
If you believe you've been targeted by recruitment fraud in the United States, you can report it to the Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3) at https://www.ic3.gov/ or the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) at https://reportfraud.ftc.gov .

records.title: Sr. Director of Quality
records.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities

records.description:
**Employment Type:** 
Full time
 
 
**Shift:** 
Day Shift
 
 
**Description:** 
The Eddy’s continuing care network, including a wide range of services—from nursing homes, assisted living, independent living, memory care, home health, hospice, PACE, infusion pharmacy to durable medical equipment—has an exciting and rewarding opportunity for a RN Director of Quality& Safety to work with teams across our network
 
 
Key responsibilities related to quality improvement include but are not limited to:
 
 

* Supporting the development of QAPI plans, goals and metrics
* Supporting and preparing reports for three Divisional QAPI Committees (Community-Based Services, Nursing Homes, and Senior Living)
* Gathering and presenting quality and safety data to the Board Quality& Safety Committee across all service lines
* Representing The Eddy Continuing Care services in a wide range of quality-related meetings
* Overall education and support of leaders across the network in continuously improving quality and outcomes

**Key responsibilities related to Safety include:** 

* Educating and support colleagues
* Facilitating meetings and the work of Safety Champions at each location
* Representing The Eddy Continuing Care Network in a wide range of Safety& Risk Management related meetings
* Preparing a wide range of reports summarizing safety/risk management related data across all service lines and development of presentations

**Education:** 

* BSN Required; MSN preferred

**Experience:** 

* Quality improvement, safety/risk management.
* Experience working in at least one continuing care service line a plus but not required (nursing homes, assisted living, independent living, memory care, home health, hospice, PACE).
* Requires expertise in using a wide range of software programs (EPIC and PCC Electronic Medical Records, MIDAS, etc.)
* Preparing concise SBARs summarizing incidents
* PowerPoint, Excel and other programs in the presentation of quality and safety data/trends, etc.

**Pay Range:** 
$116,480-$153,795.20
 
Pay is based on experience, skills, and education. Exempt positions under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) will be paid within the base salary equivalent of the stated hourly rates. The pay range may also vary within the stated range based on location.
 
 
Our Commitment
 
 
Rooted in our Mission and Core Values, we honor the dignity of every person and recognize the unique perspectives, experiences, and talents each colleague brings. By finding common ground and embracing our differences, we grow stronger together and deliver more compassionate, person-centered care. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

records.title: Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Job title:** Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance

**Reports to:** Chief Information Officer

**Division:** Central Services

**Location:** US or Waterloo

**Grade:** 23

**About Priority Commerce:**

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

**About the Role:**

The Director of QA plays a key role in protecting the reliability and integrity of Priority’s commerce platform by owning the strategy, people, and practices that ensure software is tested thoroughly before it reaches our clients. This leader builds and scales a high-performing quality organization,

modernizes test automation, and embeds quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle, from requirements through production release. The position requires deep expertise in QA leadership, test automation, and CI/CD, along with the ability to drive measurable quality outcomes in a regulated payments environment. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevOps/SRE, Security, Compliance, and Application Support to reduce production defects and customer-impacting incidents, and to accelerate safe, predictable delivery across Priority’s products.

**Responsibilities:**

* Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products.
* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
* Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression testing.
* Partners with Engineering and DevOps to integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling shift-left testing and fast, reliable release cycles.
* Oversees performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process.
* Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership.
* Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage.
* Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production.
* Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements.
* Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost.
* Collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Customer-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced.
* Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong.
* Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline.
* Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production.
* QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions.
* Audits and customer assessments find well-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises.
* The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members.

**Candidate Requirements:**

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams.
* Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams.
* Hands-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray).
* Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments.
* Working awareness of PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management.
* Experience testing cloud-native and distributed architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and high-volume transaction systems.
* Experience managing offshore, nearshore, or outsourced QA partners.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#) used for test automation.
* Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).

**Work Environment & Culture:**

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Compensation range:** $233K-$291K USD, $190K-$257K CAD 
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

**Financial Wellness**

* HSA and FSA options
* Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

**Health & Well-being**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health
* Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot
* Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

**Time Off**

* 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

**Growth & Development**

* Education expense reimbursement
* Leadership development programs
* Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

**Traditional Physical Requirements:**

* Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.
* Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.
* Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Commerce and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

records.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
* Strong leadership capability with a demonstrated ability to empower teams, identify high-potential talent, and drive employee development and succession planning.
* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Skilled at building trusted relationships and collaborating effectively with cross-functional peers, senior leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in biological or chemical sciences
* Experience with US FDA, China FDA, Health Canada, EMEA, PMDA, and ANVISA is preferred
* Knowledge of and experience with GLP and/or GCP regulatory inspections a plus
Strong operational excellence experience or qualification 

Base Salary Range 192000-270000

 
 

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing, including:

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plans with employer matching contributions
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs and resources
* Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

**Core Values**

*At Bora, our values guide everything we do — from how we solve challenges to how we support our people. We lead with a solutions-first mindset, strive to do the right thing, stay proactive, and above all, respect everyone.*

Bora Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees according to all applicable equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, directives and regulations of federal, state and local governing bodies and agencies. In keeping with this commitment, Bora Pharmaceuticals will recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including factors related to pregnancy or child birth), national origin, age, marital status, familial status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity status with regard to public assistance, employment status, local human rights commission activity, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, atypical hereditary cellular or blood trait, or any other protected category.

### **POSITION****SUMMARY:**

Working closely with the Division Head and CYP Leadership Team, the Director of Program Quality and Training of Youth Programs documents best practices, designs tools to measure staff and youth outcomes, and supports collaboration among youth-serving organizations. This role provides strategic leadership for quality improvement, staff development, and outcomes assessment across Cambridge Youth Programs’ five youth centers serving more than 1,200 youth ages 9–19, partnering with the Division Head and CYP Leadership Team to codify best practices, build measurement tools, and strengthen collaboration among youth-serving organizations. The Director directly supervises an Administrative Assistant and a Youth Connector, and manages organization-wide partnerships, grant implementation and reporting, and recruitment and outreach efforts.

### **ESSENTIAL****JOB****FUNCTIONS****and****DUTIES:**

*The**essential**functions**or**duties**listed**below**are**intended**only**as**illustrations**of**the**various**type**of**work**that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position.*

* Support expanded learning and out-of-school-time programs serving youth ages 9–19 across the City’s youth centers, including afterschool programs, evening programs, school vacation programming, and specialized youth activities.
* Assist the Division Head for Youth Programs in establishing program goals, objectives, and operational priorities.
* Assist with oversight of programs and activities across the City’s youth centers and collaborate with

 Youth Program staff as part of the Cambridge Youth Programs Leadership Team.
* Provide strategic oversight and support for program quality improvement initiatives and develop systems to assess, track, and manage program performance using positive youth development principles.
* Develop and implement systems to identify staff training and professional development needs and design and deliver training programs that support best practices in youth development, out-of-school-time programming, and effective supervision.
* Provide guidance and support to program staff in program planning, implementation, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Develop and manage organization-wide partnerships, initiatives, and grant partnerships, including implementation oversight and grant reporting; support recruitment materials development and outreach to prospective participants and partner organizations.
* Supervise a Youth Connector who develops and supports sites around middle school and teen transition programs, pre-teen, middle school, and teen recruitment and enrollment, and the organization’s social media plan.
* Provide direct coaching support to assigned youth center sites, working with Program Directors on a weekly basis to develop, implement, and assess both site-based plans and collective projects across the organization.
* Collaborate with the Director of Youth Program Operations to design and implement tools that measure staff and youth outcomes, support organizational accountability, and evaluate program effectiveness.
* Collaborate with the Director of Youth Program Operations, develop, coordinate, and manage staff trainings and professional development for full-time and part-time staff.
* Conduct program evaluations, analyze data, and prepare quarterly reports that support performance measurement and continuous improvement efforts.
* Develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders and support collaboration and resource sharing among youth centers, schools, community organizations, families, and public safety partners.
* Perform related duties as required.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

***Education/Experience***

* A bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* Three (3) years of out-of-school time (OST) program management experience required.
* Five (5) years of experience supervising staff and working with diverse populations required.
* Demonstrated knowledge of positive youth development principles and experience in program development required.
* Experience developing and implementing systems for program delivery, staff training, program quality improvement, evaluation, and assessment processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct line authority and provide leadership in developing and sustaining collaborative internal and external partnerships.
* Experience working with community agencies, youth, and schools required.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, writing, organizational, and facilitation skills required.
* An equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant lived or professional experience may be considered.

***Knowledge,******Skills,******and*** ***Abilities:***
-------------------------------------------------------

* Deep knowledge of positive youth development, out-of-school time program models, and trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and linguistically responsive practices.
* Skill in designing, facilitating, and evaluating staff training using adult learning principles, coaching strategies, and reflective supervision techniques.
* Ability to develop and implement program quality frameworks and assessment tools and use qualitative and quantitative data to support continuous improvement efforts.
* Strong facilitation, presentation, and written communication skills, including the ability to convene diverse stakeholders and lead collaborative problem-solving initiatives across multiple sites.
* Proficiency with data management, project management, and budgeting tools and systems.
* Ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and competing priorities while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and regulations.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, and leadership skills with the ability to build and sustain collaborative partnerships.
* Commitment to anti-racism, diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Ability to work and interact effectively with individuals and groups across diverse identities, cultures, backgrounds, and ideologies.

### **SUPERVISION****RECEIVED:**

### **Works****under****the****general****direction****of****the****Division****Head****of****Cambridge****Youth****Programs;****exercises****considerable independent judgment; and has work reviewed through conferences, reports, and achievement of program** **objectives.**

### 

### **SUPERVISION****EXERCISED:**

### **May****directly****supervise****two full-time staff members:****an****Administrative Assistant and a Youth Connector.****Also provides functional supervision and coaching support to Program Directors and staff across assigned youth center sites; may oversee consultants or interns engaged in training, program quality, and evaluation** **initiatives.**

### 

### **WORK** **ENVIRONMENT:**

### **Work is performed in a standard office setting with fluorescent lighting, carpeted floors, air conditioning, and moderate noise levels. Evening and weekend hours may be required to support operational needs.**

### 

### **PHYSICAL** **DEMANDS:**

### **Ability****to****use****a****computer****to****access,****input,****and****retrieve****information;****answer****telephones;****maintain****multiple****files; and lift items weighing up to 25 pounds. Ability to travel throughout the City of Cambridge to multiple Youth Center locations as required.**

*The City of Cambridge's workforce, like the community it serves, is diverse. Applicants must have the ability to**work and interact**effectively**with**individuals**and**groups**with**a variety of**identities, cultures, backgrounds, and ideologies.*

**COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY**

The City of Cambridge is committed to providing fair, transparent, and competitive compensation to all employees. The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the full range for this position's pay grade (Steps 1–10). New employees joining the organization are hired within the hiring range, Steps 1 through 5, with placement at the midpoint reserved for the most qualified candidates. Starting placement is based on directly related education and experience relative to the minimum qualifications of the position, required licenses or certifications, internal equity with current employees, and relevant labor market factors. Employees progress through the 10 steps over time through the City's established step and pay progression policies.

This compensation philosophy applies to non‑union positions. For union positions, please refer to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Current City employees applying to another position should refer to the Compensation & Classification Manual for the policies governing promotions, lateral transfers, and other internal salary changes.

**ABOUT THE CITY OF CAMBRIDGE**

The City of Cambridge is a diverse and vibrant community that 120,000 residents of different ethnic, racial, religious, U.S. nationals and other backgrounds call home. We take pride in our City’s diversity and strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the community we serve - one in which all employees can thrive. The City is also deeply committed to creating an environment in which all our employees are treated equitably and feel included. In joining our team, you would work in a workplace environment that advances and values antiracism, diversity, equity, and inclusion (ADEI), and that is committed to embedding ADEI best practices and tenets in all aspects of our work. City of Cambridge residents are especially encouraged to apply to job openings.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY / AFFIRMATIVE ACTION**

The City of Cambridge is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, sex, religion, age, national origin, disability, or any other protected category. Women, minorities, veterans, members of the LGBTQ+ Community, and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply. The City is committed to advancing a workforce culture of antiracism, diversity, equity, and inclusion. Auxiliary aids and services, written materials in alternative formats, and reasonable modifications in policies and procedures will be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities free of charge, upon request by contacting Human Resources at humanresources@cambridgema.gov.
